name: DVS Resource Map
description:
This dataset is a directory of 253 social service locations in New York State, all in NY, compiled as a resource map. Each row describes one service site, including its name, the type of service offered (such as supportive services, homelessness assistance, advocacy, employment, or financial assistance), operating hours, phone number, street address, city, ZIP code, borough, and optional building details like floor or entrance. Most records also indicate whether walk-ins are accepted, and some include an email address, website, and a short description of the specific services provided.

The data can be used to help residents, caseworkers, or referral hotlines find nearby assistance by service type or neighborhood, and to compare coverage across boroughs and cities. It also supports analysis of how services are distributed geographically, which categories are most common, and which locations offer walk-in access or online contact options.
